LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_UseGizmoDesc: Select a colonist to kneel in continuous prayer before {0}. Stop prayer between 20s and 80s to heal the colony safely.
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_StopGizmoDesc: Order {0} to cease praying to Flesh Idol. Warning: Stopping before 20s invites retribution!
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_MiracleStarted: {0}'s flesh begins to pulse warmly—the healing miracle has awakened! (Remember to stop before 80s.)
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_MiracleEnded: {0}'s prayer concludes safely within the grace window.
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_OverloadWarning: Warning: {0} is trembling violently! End the prayer immediately before 90s!
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_EarlyStopPunish: {0} abandoned prayer to Flesh Idol too soon and suffered vicious spiritual backlash!
LanguageData.LC_FleshIdol_ExplosionLetterDesc: Over-devotion past ninety seconds caused {0} to erupt in a catastrophic psychic and erosive shockwave across the map!
